title: Discount panics when the coupon code is unknown
body:
`Discount` should leave the amount alone when the coupon code is not in
the rates map. Instead it panics.

```bash
go run ./cmd/shop
```

```
panic: runtime error: integer divide by zero

goroutine 1 [running]:
example.com/shop/pricing.applyRate(...)
	/home/dana/src/shop/pricing/pricing.go:10
example.com/shop/pricing.Discount(...)
	/home/dana/src/shop/pricing/pricing.go:6
main.main()
	/home/dana/src/shop/cmd/shop/main.go:11 +0x124
exit status 2
```

`go test ./pricing/` fails the same way in `TestDiscountUnknownCode`.
